name: floating-toolbar
title: Floating Toolbar
description: Floating, horizontally scrollable toolbar of icon options built on ui-sdk; options can open a panel, and panel items can open a second panel over the first with a back item.

files.content:
"use client"

import { ToolbarSeparator } from "@ui-sdk/react/toolbar"

import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"

import type { FloatingToolbarSeparatorProps } from "./floating-toolbar.types"
import { floatingToolbarSeparatorClasses } from "./floating-toolbar.variants"

export function FloatingToolbarSeparator({ className, ...props }: FloatingToolbarSeparatorProps) {
  return <ToolbarSeparator className={cn(floatingToolbarSeparatorClasses, className)} {...props} />
}

export { FloatingToolbar } from "./floating-toolbar"
export { FloatingToolbarButton } from "./floating-toolbar-button"
export { FloatingToolbarMenu } from "./floating-toolbar-menu"
export { FloatingToolbarMenuContent } from "./floating-toolbar-menu-content"
export { FloatingToolbarMenuItem } from "./floating-toolbar-menu-item"
export { FloatingToolbarMenuTrigger } from "./floating-toolbar-menu-trigger"
export { FloatingToolbarSeparator } from "./floating-toolbar-separator"
export { FloatingToolbarSubmenu } from "./floating-toolbar-submenu"
export { FloatingToolbarSubmenuContent } from "./floating-toolbar-submenu-content"
export { FloatingToolbarSubmenuTrigger } from "./floating-toolbar-submenu-trigger"
export type {
  FloatingToolbarButtonProps,
  FloatingToolbarMenuContentProps,
  FloatingToolbarMenuItemProps,
  FloatingToolbarMenuProps,
  FloatingToolbarMenuTriggerProps,
  FloatingToolbarNumbering,
  FloatingToolbarPlacement,
  FloatingToolbarProps,
  FloatingToolbarSeparatorProps,
  FloatingToolbarSide,
  FloatingToolbarSubmenuContentProps,
  FloatingToolbarSubmenuProps,
  FloatingToolbarSubmenuTriggerProps,
} from "./floating-toolbar.types"
